description: Give the active project a live backend on Rebase Cloud with no account or signup: provisions a project, sets REBASE_BASE_URL in .env, links the directory and deploys the local collections to it (`rebase cloud init --claim`), then sets REBASE_API_TOKEN in .env: a key the deployed app accepts, for reading and writing data through its row-level security, expiring with the claim window. Returns the live URL, the admin panel URL and a claim URL. Give the claim URL to the user: whoever opens it and signs in owns the project. Unclaimed, it is deleted after 72 hours. Afterwards `rebase cloud` commands in the directory act on it without a login.

deploy.description: Deploy the collections now. Default true; false provisions and links only

name.description: What to call the app (optional, up to 200 characters)

name: rebase_cloud_provision
